import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    nums = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))
    s = set(nums)
    best = 0
    for x in s:
        if x - 1 in s:
            continue
        cur = x
        length = 1
        while cur + 1 in s:
            cur += 1
            length += 1
        best = max(best, length)
    print(best)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def trap(height):
    n = len(height)
    l, r = 0, n - 1
    lmax = rmax = 0
    ans = 0
    while l <= r:
        if lmax <= rmax:
            lmax = max(lmax, height[l])
            ans += lmax - height[l]
            l += 1
        else:
            rmax = max(rmax, height[r])
            ans += rmax - height[r]
            r -= 1
    return ans

import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    nums = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))
    k = int(data[1 + n])
    cnt = {0: 1}
    pre = 0
    ans = 0
    for x in nums:
        pre += x
        ans += cnt.get(pre - k, 0)
        cnt[pre] = cnt.get(pre, 0) + 1
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
